label: ἐνέργεια -- ἐντελέχεια equivocation

dependency_edge.note: κίνησις is defined as ἐντελέχεια τοῦ δυνάμει ὄντος; τέλειον analysis grounds ἐντελέχεια

conflict_edge.note: ἐνέργεια = becoming-completed vs. ἐντελέχεια = completedness; kinesis is ἐνέργεια not ἐντελέχεια, yet the definition uses 'ἐντελέχεια'

productive_character: Movement IS the presence (ἐντελέχεια) of what is able to be there precisely insofar as it is not yet completed (ἐνέργεια). The equivocation is ontologically necessary.

label: δύναμις: already-there vs. not-yet

dependency_edge.note: δύναμις enters the definition of κίνησις as the being-character of the δυνάμει ὄν

conflict_edge.note: Heidegger insists δύναμις is already-there as availability, yet the definition requires the δυνάμει ὄν to be 'not yet' completed

productive_character: Meaningfulness (Bedeutsamkeit) and potentiality are two faces of the same phenomenon. The world is encountered as meaningful-available-for, and this availability constitutes the from...toward... structure of movement.

label: λόγος: disclosure vs. concealment

dependency_edge.note: λόγος is the fundamental determination of human being-there and the bearer/mastery of interpretedness

conflict_edge.note: λόγος enables idle chatter, dissimulation, and the dominance of ψεῦδος; dominant λόγοι can render beings inaccessible

productive_character: Conceptuality has a 'double sense' precisely because the same λόγος that discloses also conceals. The fore-structures must be both overcome and appropriated. This tension drives the entire Second Part.

label: δόξα: everydayness vs. ground of science

dependency_edge.note: δόξα is also the basis for the mode of grasping beings designated as ἐπιστήμη

conflict_edge.note: δόξα is characterized by stubbornness and das Man anonymity, contrasting with ἐπιστήμη's secure knowing of the ἀεί

productive_character: Theoretical science arises from and against the background of δόξα. Science is the transformation, not the abolition, of everyday opinion.

label: πάθη ground λόγος vs. λόγος grounds being-there

dependency_edge.note: πάθη are 'the ground out of which speaking arises and which what is expressed grows back into'

conflict_edge.note: λόγος is the fundamental determination of the being of the human being, making it appear more fundamental than the πάθη

productive_character: Neither is simply more fundamental. They are equiprimordial (gleichursprünglich) -- anticipating BT's analysis of Rede, Befindlichkeit, and Verstehen as co-original existentialia.

label: ἀρετή: μεσότης vs. ἀκρότης
node_a: ἀρετή as μεσότης (the mean πρὸς ἡμᾶς)
node_b: ἀρετή as ἀκρότης (the highest with regard to the εὖ)

dependency_edge.note: The οὐσία of ἀρετή = μεσότης; ἀρετή is defined through μεσότης

conflict_edge.note: Taken ontologically, ἀρετή μεσότης is simultaneously ἀκρότης -- the mean is the extreme

productive_character: The tension dissolves when μεσότης is understood as a way of being-composed (the 'how') rather than a quantitative midpoint. The mean is the extreme because it is the mode of being most genuinely related to the concrete situation (καιρός).

label: φόβος: disposition vs. world-side structure

dependency_edge.note: Fear requires both the dispositional ground (οἴεσθαι) and the world-side encounter characters

conflict_edge.note: There is 'no parallel' between the frightening and being-afraid -- the two sides cannot be mapped onto each other

productive_character: The non-parallelism shows that dispositions are not reactions to pre-given objects but disclosive modes of being-in-the-world. The gap between φοβερά and φόβος makes fear a finding-oneself rather than a causal response.
